svg.desc: A timeline of clicks and their conversions relative to a training cutoff T. Early clicks have converted before T and are labelled correctly; a recent click converts after T and is wrongly labelled negative; another has not converted yet. Two fixes: a wait window, or a delay-aware likelihood that multiplies pCVR by the delay CDF F of the elapsed time.

svg.text: At training time, recent clicks have not had time to convert, so they look like negatives.

svg.text: Fix 1: wait window (train on clicks ≥ W days old). Fix 2: delay-aware likelihood:

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: P(y_obs = 1 | x, e) = pCVR(x) · F(e), F(e) = 1 − e^(−e/τ). A 12-hour-old click, τ = 48 h: F = 1 − e^(−0.25) = 22%.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Delayed feedback is mostly a calibration problem: the naive model under-predicts most on the freshest traffic.
